patterns: Cloudflare envelope: {success, errors, messages, result, result_info}
modified_on timestamp on most resources for delta sync
API tokens (Bearer) preferred; legacy email+key still supported
Cloudflare's own Code Mode MCP pattern: search+execute

novel_features.name: Idempotent DNS apply
novel_features.description: Apply a single DNS record with no-op-if-identical semantics, so the same command is safe to run repeatedly.
novel_features.rationale: Existing CLIs error on duplicate; the only way to make DNS provisioning idempotent today is a wrapper script around list+create+update.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when you need to provision DNS from a script or agent — guaranteed safe to run again with the same args.

novel_features.name: Semantic redirect shortcut
novel_features.description: Create a 301/302 redirect from a URL pattern to a URL template — the Page Rule under the hood is composed for you.
novel_features.rationale: Page Rules' forwarding_url action requires careful JSON; nobody wraps it semantically.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when you want a domain-level 301 redirect without hand-rolling a Page Rule body.

novel_features.name: DNS propagation verifier
novel_features.description: Verify a DNS record has propagated by querying multiple public resolvers (Cloudflare 1.1.1.1, Google 8.8.8.8, Quad9 9.9.9.9).
novel_features.rationale: Cloudflare's own API tells you the record exists at Cloudflare; it can't tell you what other resolvers see.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this immediately after `dns apply` to confirm the record is visible globally before kicking off downstream steps.

novel_features.name: Cross-product domain locator
novel_features.description: Find every place a hostname appears across DNS records, Worker routes, Page Rules, Access apps, and Custom Hostnames in one command.
novel_features.rationale: Local SQLite cache joins data that no single API call can — Cloudflare's product silos make this dashboard-impossible.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this before deleting or changing a domain — check that nothing else depends on it.

novel_features.name: Zone drift diff
novel_features.description: Diff two zones across settings, page rules, and DNS records (semantic name+type match) to find drift.
novel_features.rationale: Cloudflare's dashboard has no diff view; Terraform requires you to manage both zones declaratively.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this before promoting staging to prod, during incident review, or when onboarding a tenant zone from a template.

novel_features.name: Worker single-pane bindings
novel_features.description: Show every binding (KV, R2, D1, queue, secret, cron, route, custom domain) for one Worker in a single table.
novel_features.rationale: Wrangler exposes the pieces but never unifies them; the dashboard requires multiple tabs.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when debugging a Worker in production — see everything wired to it without 10 dashboard tabs.

novel_features.name: Cache purge with verify
novel_features.description: Purge cache by URL/tag/hostname and verify with cf-cache-status header probes (MISS then HIT).
novel_features.rationale: Existing purge commands fire-and-forget; verifying the purge actually landed is a separate manual step.
novel_features.example: cloudflare-pp-cli cache purge release --zone example.com --tags release-v1 --probe https://example.com/
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this in deploy/release scripts where downstream steps depend on cached content actually being purged.

novel_features.name: Setup-zone named intent
novel_features.description: End-to-end zone setup: A record, optional redirect, SSL strict, Always-Use-HTTPS — one command instead of four dashboard tabs.
novel_features.rationale: Composes the most common new-deploy workflow from individual primitives so the agent or operator runs one thing.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when wiring a new domain end-to-end — the primary intent for a freshly-deployed app.

narrative.headline: The unified Cloudflare CLI agents and operators both want — every product covered, with offline cache, agent-native output, and the Cloudflare-pattern MCP surface.
narrative.value_prop: Wrangler is Workers-only, flarectl is dormant, Terraform is declarative-only. This CLI absorbs all three and adds cross-product transcendence: idempotent DNS apply, semantic redirects, multi-resolver propagation watch, where-is, zone drift diff. MCP exposes the entire ~3000-endpoint surface through a thin search+execute pair (the Cloudflare pattern) so agents don't burn tokens loading per-endpoint tools.
narrative.auth_narrative: Cloudflare uses scoped API tokens (Bearer) — preferred over the legacy email+global-key pair. Set `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN` once; the CLI auto-resolves account_id and zone_id from names so most commands take human-readable inputs.

quickstart.comment: verify your token works and capture account/zone IDs into local cache
snapshot zones, DNS records, workers, page rules, etc. for offline cross-product queries
end-to-end zone setup in one command
verify global DNS propagation across public resolvers
see every place this domain is wired across Cloudflare products

troubleshoots.fix: run `cloudflare-pp-cli doctor`; if token is valid, the token's permissions don't cover the resource — Cloudflare API tokens are scoped
the CLI auto-retries with the Retry-After header; if persistent, check `audit logs` for token-bound abuse alerts
run `cloudflare-pp-cli sync --full` to refresh the local cache; cross-product joins read from local SQLite

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI when you need to manage Cloudflare imperatively across multiple products in one place: DNS + Workers + Page Rules + Access + Cache + WAF. It also doubles as an MCP server with the Cloudflare-pattern search+execute pair, so agents acting on infrastructure can navigate the full ~3000-endpoint API surface without burning tokens on per-endpoint tool definitions.

recipes.title: Audit zone drift before promoting staging to prod
recipes.command: cloudflare-pp-cli zones diff staging.example.com prod.example.com --json --select drift,settings,page_rules,dns
recipes.explanation: Returns settings/page-rule/DNS deltas with --select narrowing the response so agents see only the relevant nested fields.

recipes.explanation: Local SQLite join across DNS, Worker routes, Page Rules, Access apps, custom hostnames.

recipes.title: Idempotent DNS provisioning from a script
recipes.explanation: Shows what would change without applying. Drop --dry-run to commit.

recipes.title: Cache purge with verification
recipes.command: cloudflare-pp-cli cache purge release --zone example.com --tags release-v1 --probe https://example.com/ --json
recipes.explanation: Purges by tag, then probes the URL and asserts cf-cache-status transitions from MISS to HIT.
